official_title: Commission Implementing Decision of 22.5.2023 on a standardisation request to the European Committee for Standardisation and the European Committee for Electrotechnical Standardisation in support of Union policy on artificial intelligence

corpus_assessment.inclusion_rationale: Original Commission standardisation request supporting technical standards for the emerging AI Act framework.
corpus_assessment.researcher_notes: The register identifies the decision and annexed request as M/593; implementation-stage classification is analytical. 2026-09-06 evidence update — Limited publication-month evidence only: JRC134461 PDF page 8 / printed page 5 says the request was published in May 2023, and PDF page 16 / printed page 13 identifies C(2023) 3215 final. This is not an exact day and does not verify the existing 22 May adoption date as publication. Article 4 of C(2025) 3871 supplies the previously evidenced repeal finding, but the operative repeal date and complete admission remain unresolved. The legacy record stays pending; no partial month-precision or legal-status extension is added.
